Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Pre-trade greetings now name the exact prizes and quantities Porter has ready. Added a [PRIZES] placeholder for custom greetings and a shuffled rotation of 40 lighthearted post-trade good-luck messages, with the editable custom confirmation still available when rotation is disabled.
